The main takeaway from our work is that
the representation level of a neural network can be used to improve its ability to learn new tasks.
the output layer of a neural network can be quickly recovered, but the representation is the most important factor in catastrophic forgetting.
catastrophic forgetting should be viewed as a problem that affects the representation level of a sequential learning system, not the output layer.
